title: Building and Construction Industry (Restoring Integrity and Reducing Building Costs) Bill 2024 (No. 2)
short_title: Building and Construction Industry (Restoring Integrity and Reducing Building Costs) Bill 2024 (No. 2)

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: This bill would re-establish the Australian Building and Construction Commission (ABCC) to regulate the building and construction industry.
The ABCC would have strong powers similar to those it held under the Building and Construction Industry Improvement Act 2005, including higher penalties for unlawful actions and coercion.
The explanatory memorandum does not specify a start date or the exact penalty amounts.
changes: Re-establishes the Australian Building and Construction Commission (ABCC).
Restores higher penalties for contraventions in the building industry.
Targets unlawful actions and coercion in the sector.
summary.affected: The building and construction industry, including workers, employers, unions, and consumers.
